consumes: axm.code.production-draft-revision.v1 with rendered or compiled artifact digest
external enforced sandbox executor adapter identity
optional physical save-payload store below this contract layer

sandboxScope.runtimeEnforcement: external OS process, container, VM, WASM runtime, mobile app sandbox or equivalent required

resourceModel.experimentWork: May continue while externally observed hardware health and shared pressure remain acceptable.
pressureResponsesInOrder: pause and resume after fresh health evidence
forbiddenSilentResponses: rewrite the requested product into a cheaper one

saveGate.transientExperimentVolume: not capped by save-slot count while hardware remains healthy
saveGate.fullSetBehavior: remain transient or explicitly replace one named slot using its current save digest
saveGate.replacementHistory: retain old digest and metadata receipt; old payload bytes need not remain active
saveGate.physicalPayloadStorage: provided by a lower bound storage adapter, not by this contract module

behavior.experiment: Bind a rendered production draft artifact to hypotheses, unknowns, fixtures and required observations.
behavior.execution: Issue an inert request to an explicitly bound external enforced executor; this module executes nothing.
behavior.observation: Seal digest-bound executor, containment, hardware and outcome evidence without retaining raw stdout, stderr, source or generated bulk data.
behavior.retention: A large experiment may retain a coverage summary, recipes, representative outputs and selected artifacts while declaring transient release before the run.
behavior.return: Produce draft-evidence candidates that remain separate from admission, selection, promotion, merge and CANON.

refuses: calling a text declaration OS containment
candidate execution by this metadata module
execution without an explicit enforced executor adapter
source workspace write from candidate software
hardware safety defined only by token or compute quota
more than five active save slots
more than 100000000 active payload bytes in one slot
sixth save creation during a loop
transient release without predeclared retention and coverage evidence
experiment success as correctness admission or promotion
automatic workspace mutation install deployment merge or canon
